name: SortDataTable
label: Sort Data Table
description: Sorts the data table rows in ascending or descending order by the specified column, provided that all its values have the same data type.

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The DataTable containing the data to be sorted.

fields.name: SpecifyColumnWith
fields.label: Specify Column With
fields.description: Choose whether to specify the column by name or index.

fields.name: ColumnName
fields.label: Column Name
fields.description: The name of the column to sort by (used when 'Specify Column With' is set to 'Name').

fields.name: ColumnIndex
fields.label: Column Index
fields.description: The index of the column to sort by (used when 'Specify Column With' is set to 'Index').

fields.name: Order
fields.label: Order
fields.description: Specifies whether to sort in ascending or descending order.

fields.name: SortedDataTable
fields.label: Sorted Data Table
fields.description: The DataTable after it has been sorted based on the specified criteria.
